sc: Abyssal Prowler is a companion pet that could be purchased for 5,000 oddments from the Marketplace.

Duplicate pages may still be obtained before completion of My notes if rummaging skeletons.

tx: The Apex hide boots + 2 is created by first making a unfinished apex hide draft at a pattern table, then working on it at a drafting table for 180 progress. It then turns into an unfinished apex hide boots, which needs 420 progress at a tailor's dummy to complete.
sc: It is made by upgrading an apex hide boots with 2 apex leather via the tailoring process, requiring level 100 Crafting.

tx: The Apex hide vambraces + 5 is created by first making a unfinished apex hide draft at a pattern table, then working on it at a drafting table for 288 progress. It then turns into an unfinished apex hide vambraces, which needs 672 progress at a tailor's dummy to complete.
sc: It is made by upgrading an apex hide vambraces + 4 with 16 apex leather via the tailoring process, requiring level 100 Crafting.

Augmented anima core legs of Zaros
sc: A pair of augmented anima core legs of Zaros are a level 80 melee leg slot item made by using an augmentor on anima core legs of Zaros.

The shadow-dyed augmented Ascension crossbow is a level 90 Ranged main hand weapon, created by using an augmentor on a Ascension crossbow (shadow), or by using Shadow Dye on an augmented ascension crossbow.
The augmented crystal staff is a tier 70 magic two-handed weapon created by using an augmentor on a crystal staff.
The ice-dyed augmented drygore mace is a level 90 Melee main hand weapon, created by using an augmentor on a drygore mace (ice), or by using ice dye on an augmented drygore mace.
The augmented off-hand crystal chakram is a ranged off-hand weapon created by using an augmentor on an off-hand crystal chakram.
The augmented Tavia's fishing rod is a tier 80 main hand tool, created by using an augmentor on Tavia's fishing rod.
The aviansie shield component was an item found by defeating enemies in The Bird and the Beast, or by participating the conflict.
It is dropped by General Graardor and his bodyguards, Sergeants Strongstack, Steelwill and Grimspike, in the God Wars Dungeon.

sc: Bik Templar's Outfit is a cosmetic override set unlocked by completing tier 35 of the Path of the Creators - Part II Yak Track with the premier pass.
Black Necronium Outfit is a cosmetic override outfit that can be purchased for 1 premier reward token from the Premier Token Store.
Black stone hearts are items, initially unique drops from the Shadow Reef.
It is also a reward from Zemouregal & Vorkath.

q: The ability to smith blurite bars and blurite swords
sc: Prior to 18 May 2015's update, the Blurite sword could only be obtained during the quest.

The Bottoms of Spring are an item that can be made by combining 600 Flourishing seeds.

sc: It can be made at a forge and anvil using 2 bronze bars, requiring 200 progress to complete, granting a total of 30 Smithing experience.

sc: The clover axe token is a reward from the Rainbow's End Treasure Hunter promotion.
It can be redeemed to unlock the Clover Axe and Clover Off-hand Axe, destroying the token after a confirmation prompt.
The clover crossbow token is a Treasure Hunter reward that has been obtainable during the Rainbow's End promotion.
It can be redeemed to unlock the Clover Crossbow and Clover Off-hand Crossbow, destroying the token after a confirmation prompt.

Whilst it could be obtained through any skilling (excluding Divination), it was most likely to be obtained from Cooking, Firemaking, Hunter, Runecrafting, and Agility.

Six dragonstones spawn around the room every five minutes, which players can enchant at any level.

sc: Elder Trove (Ful, T2) is obtained by killing monsters in TzKal-Zuk's encounter.

Elemental (Stormheart) Robe Top.x: Elemental (Stormheart) Robe Top is a torso slot cosmetic override that is part of the Elemental (Stormheart) set.

sc: A fishing perk enhancer is a reward from the Parcels from the Dead event.
Originally it could be obtained through the Travelling Artisan events.
Fly dragon is one of the Insects of the Desert found in Menaphos.
They may be found whilst harvesting luminous memories in Sophanem.
The Frosty Cerberus breastplate token is a reward from the Cerberus Frost Treasure Hunter promotion.
It can be redeemed to unlock the Frosty Cerberus breastplate cosmetic override, destroying the token after a confirmation prompt.
The gem necklace token is an item that was initially obtainable via Treasure Hunter during the Gemerator promotion, and later the Gemfall promotion.
It is obtained by talking to the ghost near Glarial's Tomb at the start of Curse of the Empty Lord miniquest.

Giant's hand.x: A Giant's hand is an item obtained through Balthazar Beauregard's Big Top Bonanza Distractions and Diversion. It is rewarded to players who earn between 1 and 500 points in any of the circus performances, and is the last piece of the Audience costume. If players lose this item, they can talk to Balthazar Beauregard to obtain another.

The Gnomeballer's shorts is a cosmetic item that is available from Treasure Hunter.
Golden Ahrim's Equipment is a cosmetic override outfit that can be purchased for 1 golden cosmetic token from the Golden Goods shop.
Golden chaotic rapier is a main hand melee weapon cosmetic override that can be purchased alongside its off-hand variant for 1 golden cosmetic token from the Golden Goods shop.
It is obtained by killing the Giant sea snake encountered at the end of the quest.

Hellion Boots.x: The Hellion Boots are a feet slot cosmetic override that can be purchased, along with the rest of the Hellion outfit, for 1 premier reward token from the Premier Token Store. They could originally be unlocked upon purchasing the 2018 Premier Club package or the 2018 Summer Special.

Necturion Gauntlets.x: The Necturion Gauntlets are a hands slot cosmetic override that is part of the Necturion Outfit. Along with the rest of the outfit, they can be unlocked by spending 100% respect in the Artisans' Workshop.

Nocturnal Lantern.x: The Nocturnal Lantern is an off-hand necromancy weapon cosmetic override that can be obtained by purchasing the Nocturnal Weapon Bundle.

sc: An oak clock flatpack can be made at a workbench (Oak workbench or better) in the workshop of a player-owned house.

Pirate hats can be obtained from hard reward caskets.

It can't be obtained as an item.

Raptor (Advanced) Gauntlets.x: The Raptor (Advanced) Gauntlets are a hands slot cosmetic override that can be obtained by defeating any combination of 50 Wyverns, Ripper Demons, Camel Warriors and Acheron mammoths with the Raptor outfit unlocked.
